svg.aria-label: Architecture: requests are scheduled, drafted, verified and committed by the engine over a paged KV cache; every state change becomes an event sent over a WebSocket or to a trace file; in the browser a player, timeline, reducer and panels rebuild it.
svg.text: One engine step, in order. Every box names the file that implements it.
req_* · step_* · block_* · draft_propose · verify · token
CHECKED BY pytest: parity with transformers · lossless speculation · allocator invariants
replay.py + reducer.test.ts: the rebuilt state equals every engine snapshot
